subsystems.name: System Integration and Lifecycle Validation Architecture

contracts.invariant: Every platform assertion is explicit and closed to unknown states.
Every required platform result must be PASS.
Compatibility evidence never grants deployment authority.
Identity, authorization, privacy, safety, cost, and evidence are evaluated independently.
A false or missing gate denies admission.
Local contract validation cannot mint an execution permit.
A receipt may record execution but never manufacture prior authority.
Providers and capabilities are deny-by-default allowlists.
Requests use a closed field set and non-negative bounded cost.
Local routing performs no provider dispatch.
Every result declares terminal state, authority, and external-effect state.
Every parent references an earlier immutable event.
Telemetry is descriptive and cannot grant authority.
Missing or malformed evidence blocks downstream admission.
Indeterminate outcomes require reconciliation before retry.

subsystems.name: Coordinated Human-Orchestrated Runtime and User Surface

contracts.invariant: Human-facing intent is non-empty and explicit.
Consequential intent requires human approval and cannot execute from presentation alone.
Accessibility remains an evidence obligation rather than an inferred claim.
Consent is never inferred from silence, memory, or prior approval.
